instructions:
These tools drive the Windows OneNote desktop client through its COM automation interface, from WSL.
They work with the user's own signed-in notebooks, so writes land in real notes that sync to SharePoint/OneDrive.

Identifying a page: prefer pageId, taken from pages or search. When only names are known, pass notebook + section + page together;
a section name that exists in several notebooks is rejected as ambiguous.

Writing is always two steps. Call a write tool without dryRun: nothing is written, the reply starts with 'applyToken: <token>' and shows the exact
change OneNote would receive. To apply, repeat the same call with dryRun=false and that applyToken. A token is single use, expires after 10 minutes,
belongs to one server process, and is refused when the arguments differ or the target changed in OneNote after the dry run.
If an apply is interrupted its outcome is unknown: read the page again and preview before retrying.

Several changes: batch takes a list of ops, each one of append_lines, insert_table, insert_image or edit with that tool's
arguments; it previews all of them, returns one applyToken and applies them in order. Prefer it when several independent changes to
one page are planned, so the caller confirms once. Two ops that rewrite the same outline are refused: put several changes inside one
outline in one edit call. create_page and delete_page are not batched. If a change fails, the error says what landed and what was
not attempted.

Editing text: OneNote replaces an entire outline with whatever one:OEChildren the caller sends, so a paragraph omitted from that list is DELETED.
That is why edit exists and why it resends each affected outline in full, echoing back OneNote's own XML for everything it is not changing.
Use edit for changes inside an outline and append_lines for a new outline at the end of a page. Raw outline XML is never accepted.

Formatting: a line is a plain string, or an object with text, depth, list, quickStyle, alignment, spaceBefore,
spaceAfter and style (fontFamily, fontSize, colour, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight). Depth
nests a paragraph under the nearest earlier one at the previous level, which is how a bullet tree is written.
A quickStyle name is resolved against the page's own QuickStyleDef list, so pass the index read_page reported
when the page does not define that name. insert_image, insert_table and edit append take after: the objectID
of a paragraph to insert after, at any depth.

Concurrency: lastModifiedTime does not advance when content is written through COM and the hierarchy API can report a different value than the page
itself, so it is informational only. Safety comes from the token's content fingerprint, and delete_page additionally requires the exact page name.

tools.name: notebooks
tools.title: OneNote notebooks
tools.description: List the Microsoft OneNote notebooks and sections available in the user's Windows OneNote desktop client.

tools.name: pages
tools.title: OneNote pages
tools.description: List the pages in one OneNote section. Pass sectionId, or notebook plus section names. Returns names, ids and creation times; for a page's live modification time use read_page.

section.description: Section name, required when sectionId is omitted

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search OneNote
tools.description: Find OneNote pages by name across every notebook. Matching is a case-insensitive substring match on the page name; page bodies are not searched.

query.description: Substring to look for in page names

tools.name: read_page
tools.title: Read OneNote page
tools.description: Read one OneNote page: its paragraphs as text, each with the objectID needed to reference it in edit, plus its outlines, tables and images. The reported lastModified is informational and must not be used as a concurrency check.

pageId.description: Page ID from pages or search. Preferred.

notebook.description: Notebook name, used with section and page when pageId is unknown

includeXml.description: Also return the raw OneNote XML. Large, and it includes the author's account metadata.

style.description: OneNote's cascaded text style for the paragraph, when it has one

tools.name: create_page
tools.title: Create OneNote page
tools.description: Create a new page in a OneNote section with a title and optional body paragraphs, each its own paragraph in one outline. A line is a plain string, or an object that adds depth, a list, a quick style and character formatting to it. The dry run validates the section but cannot show the page, which does not exist yet. Two steps: call it without dryRun first (nothing is written; the reply starts with a line 'applyToken: <token>' and shows the exact change), then call it again with the same arguments plus dryRun=false and that applyToken. A token is single use, expires after 10 minutes, and is refused if the arguments differ or the target changed in OneNote after the dry run.

section.description: Section name, required when sectionId is omitted

depth.description: 0 is the outline's top level; a paragraph at depth d nests under the nearest earlier paragraph at depth d-1

anyOf.description: Style name the page defines, or an index from read_page. OneNote maps the index onto a style the page defines and may normalise it, so read_page is the source of truth

spaceBefore.description: Space above the paragraph, in points

spaceAfter.description: Space below the paragraph, in points

dryRun.description: Default true: preview only. Pass false, together with applyToken, to apply.

applyToken.description: The applyToken from the dry run of this same call. Required when dryRun is false.

style.description: OneNote's cascaded text style for the paragraph, when it has one

tools.name: append_lines
tools.title: Append to OneNote page
tools.description: Append paragraphs to a page as a new outline at the end. Existing content is not touched. A line is a plain string, or an object that adds depth, a list, a quick style and character formatting to it; depth nests a paragraph under the nearest earlier one at the previous level. Use this for adding to the end of a page; use edit to change text inside an existing outline. Two steps: call it without dryRun first (nothing is written; the reply starts with a line 'applyToken: <token>' and shows the exact change), then call it again with the same arguments plus dryRun=false and that applyToken. A token is single use, expires after 10 minutes, and is refused if the arguments differ or the target changed in OneNote after the dry run.

pageId.description: Page ID from pages or search. Preferred.

notebook.description: Notebook name, used with section and page when pageId is unknown

depth.description: 0 is the outline's top level; a paragraph at depth d nests under the nearest earlier paragraph at depth d-1

anyOf.description: Style name the page defines, or an index from read_page. OneNote maps the index onto a style the page defines and may normalise it, so read_page is the source of truth

spaceBefore.description: Space above the paragraph, in points

spaceAfter.description: Space below the paragraph, in points

dryRun.description: Default true: preview only. Pass false, together with applyToken, to apply.

applyToken.description: The applyToken from the dry run of this same call. Required when dryRun is false.

style.description: OneNote's cascaded text style for the paragraph, when it has one

tools.name: insert_table
tools.title: Insert OneNote table
tools.description: Insert a table into a page: give headers and rows as arrays of cell text. Without outline it becomes a new outline at the end of the page; with outline it is appended inside that existing outline; with after it goes right after that paragraph instead. Cells are single paragraphs and cannot contain nested tables. Two steps: call it without dryRun first (nothing is written; the reply starts with a line 'applyToken: <token>' and shows the exact change), then call it again with the same arguments plus dryRun=false and that applyToken. A token is single use, expires after 10 minutes, and is refused if the arguments differ or the target changed in OneNote after the dry run.

pageId.description: Page ID from pages or search. Preferred.

notebook.description: Notebook name, used with section and page when pageId is unknown

bordersVisible.description: Draw cell borders; OneNote's default is false

hasHeaderRow.description: Render the first row as a header row

outline.description: objectID of an existing outline to append the table to

after.description: objectID of a paragraph to insert after, at any depth; the outline is derived from it when outline is omitted

dryRun.description: Default true: preview only. Pass false, together with applyToken, to apply.

applyToken.description: The applyToken from the dry run of this same call. Required when dryRun is false.

style.description: OneNote's cascaded text style for the paragraph, when it has one

tools.name: insert_image
tools.title: Insert OneNote image
tools.description: Insert an image file into a page, read from a path this server can reach (a WSL path, or /mnt/c/... for a file on the Windows side). Without outline it becomes a new outline at the end of the page; with outline it is appended inside that existing outline; with after it goes right after that paragraph instead. Without width and height OneNote picks the size. The image is embedded as given: crop it before calling if only part of it belongs on the page. Two steps: call it without dryRun first (nothing is written; the reply starts with a line 'applyToken: <token>' and shows the exact change), then call it again with the same arguments plus dryRun=false and that applyToken. A token is single use, expires after 10 minutes, and is refused if the arguments differ or the target changed in OneNote after the dry run.

pageId.description: Page ID from pages or search. Preferred.

notebook.description: Notebook name, used with section and page when pageId is unknown

path.description: Image file path readable from this server

format.description: png, jpg, emf or auto; derived from the extension when omitted

alt.description: Alternative text stored on the image

outline.description: objectID of an existing outline to append the image to

after.description: objectID of a paragraph to insert after, at any depth; the outline is derived from it when outline is omitted

dryRun.description: Default true: preview only. Pass false, together with applyToken, to apply.

applyToken.description: The applyToken from the dry run of this same call. Required when dryRun is false.

style.description: OneNote's cascaded text style for the paragraph, when it has one

tools.name: edit
tools.title: Edit OneNote page text
tools.description: Change paragraphs inside existing outlines of a page: replace their text with set, delete them with remove, or add paragraphs to an outline with append, optionally after a given paragraph. Paragraph objectIDs come from read_page, and outline objectIDs may be used as an append target. OneNote replaces an outline with exactly what the caller sends, so this tool resends each affected outline in full, echoing back OneNote's own XML for everything it is not changing - that is why paragraph XML is never accepted from callers. Two steps: call it without dryRun first (nothing is written; the reply starts with a line 'applyToken: <token>' and shows the exact change), then call it again with the same arguments plus dryRun=false and that applyToken. A token is single use, expires after 10 minutes, and is refused if the arguments differ or the target changed in OneNote after the dry run.

pageId.description: Page ID from pages or search. Preferred.

notebook.description: Notebook name, used with section and page when pageId is unknown

objectID.description: objectID of the paragraph to replace

items.description: objectID of a paragraph to delete

objectID.description: objectID of the outline (or of any paragraph in it) to add to

depth.description: 0 is the outline's top level; a paragraph at depth d nests under the nearest earlier paragraph at depth d-1

anyOf.description: Style name the page defines, or an index from read_page. OneNote maps the index onto a style the page defines and may normalise it, so read_page is the source of truth

spaceBefore.description: Space above the paragraph, in points

spaceAfter.description: Space below the paragraph, in points

lines.description: Paragraphs to add inside that outline

after.description: objectID of a paragraph in that outline to insert after

append.description: Paragraphs to add inside an existing outline

dryRun.description: Default true: preview only. Pass false, together with applyToken, to apply.

applyToken.description: The applyToken from the dry run of this same call. Required when dryRun is false.

style.description: OneNote's cascaded text style for the paragraph, when it has one

tools.name: delete_page
tools.title: Delete OneNote page
tools.description: Delete a OneNote page. It goes to the notebook's recycle bin, so it can be restored from OneNote. expectName is required and must match the page the target resolves to, so a stale or wrong id cannot delete a different page. Two steps: call it without dryRun first (nothing is written; the reply starts with a line 'applyToken: <token>' and shows the exact change), then call it again with the same arguments plus dryRun=false and that applyToken. A token is single use, expires after 10 minutes, and is refused if the arguments differ or the target changed in OneNote after the dry run.

pageId.description: Page ID from pages or search. Preferred.

notebook.description: Notebook name, used with section and page when pageId is unknown

expectName.description: Exact page name the target must have; required safety check

dryRun.description: Default true: preview only. Pass false, together with applyToken, to apply.

applyToken.description: The applyToken from the dry run of this same call. Required when dryRun is false.

style.description: OneNote's cascaded text style for the paragraph, when it has one

tools.name: batch
tools.title: Apply several OneNote changes
tools.description: Apply several changes with one confirmation. Each op carries tool (append_lines, insert_table, insert_image or edit) plus that tool's arguments. The dry run previews every change and returns one applyToken; the apply runs them in order and stops at the first failure, reporting what landed. Two ops must not rewrite the same outline, because the second fingerprint would be stale once the first is applied: use one edit call for several changes inside an outline. create_page and delete_page are not accepted because they need their own confirmation. Two steps: call it without dryRun first (nothing is written; the reply starts with a line 'applyToken: <token>' and shows the exact change), then call it again with the same arguments plus dryRun=false and that applyToken. A token is single use, expires after 10 minutes, and is refused if the arguments differ or the target changed in OneNote after the dry run.

tool.description: One of append_lines, insert_table, insert_image or edit

items.description: One change: tool plus that tool's arguments, without dryRun or applyToken.

ops.description: The changes, applied in this order

dryRun.description: Default true: preview only. Pass false, together with applyToken, to apply.

applyToken.description: The applyToken from the dry run of this same call. Required when dryRun is false.

style.description: OneNote's cascaded text style for the paragraph, when it has one
